title: Products with stock above threshold
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on products(id, name, category, stock_qty, price).
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT name, stock_qty FROM products WHERE stock_qty > 10 ORDER BY stock_qty DESC

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR(50), category VARCHAR(50), stock_qty INT, price DECIMAL); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Laptop', 'Tech', 5, 1000), (2, 'Mouse', 'Tech', 15, 20), (3, 'Keyboard', 'Tech', 12, 50), (4, 'Desk', 'Furniture', 2, 200), (5, 'Chair', 'Furniture', 20, 100);
